p.d: Who gets to be called a hero? From freedom fighters to activists and social media personalities, we meet Africans who have changed lives and shaped the course of history. But is a hero defined by popularity, or by the lasting impact they leave on the world?

Hear Ibiza and you think of nightlife, world-class DJs and never-ending parties. Now, the Spanish islands tourism board hopes to start attracting families. We meet members of Ibizas club scene and people whove known it since its iconic hippie days to find out what they make of the plan. _x000D_Could it work without Ibiza losing what made it famous?_x000D_

Legacy automakers are facing multiple crises at once. Could that be a chance to reinvent themselves and the car itself? Will your next ride be solar-powered? And: Meet two sisters who brave the streets of Lagos on bikes.
Athletes in the Baltic states are combining elite sports with military service as Russias war in Ukraine reshapes regional security. The line between competitor and defender is increasingly blurred.

Why do many strawberries taste less flavorful today, and can scientists bring back their aroma? We explore the quest for the perfect strawberry, along with new ways to cut food waste and create more sustainable foods.
Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.
A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

Warren has arrived into Cape Town. This won’t be your average culinary exploration of a city; Warren has dedicated the entire episode to diving into a specific style of South African cooking known as 『Cape Malay』.
Warren is in the Franschhoek Valley, exploring the endless bounty of Boschendal Wine Estate.
Continuing to listen to his heart, Warren deepens his love of wine by venturing to the lesser known town of Hermanus, where he』ll visit Newton Johnson, the 『wine farm with a view』.

Warren is heading out of Cape Town into the more quiet coastal area of the Western Cape, and the picturesque town of Paternoster. It’s here he』ll marvel at the seaside village feel and take an e-bike ride along the beach.
As the final stanza in Warren’s Food Trail of South Africa, he’s back in the bush, a quintessential part of all travel to the rainbow nation.
In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.
Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.
Adam Liaw discovers a host of delights in Japan. On the wintry northern island of Hokkaido, he samples sea urchin, pond smelt and boutique cheesecake.
Adam goes to sea with the fishermen who caught the so-called `million-dollar tuna. He also meets a soy sauce maker who saved his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

p.d: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…
A hilarious reality show about four famous male celebrities from different countries on an all-expenses-paid fantasy vacation in Hong Kong, tailor-made for the “bros”!

Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling solves supernatural mysteries and battles evil spirits. During her investigations, she crosses paths with mysterious detective Fong, whose hidden past is tied to a dark destiny. Though distrustful at first, the two become allies and join forces to confront a terrifying evil threatening the city.

After being defeated in a championship match, Muay Thai fighter Koy awakens in a surreal dreamscape shaped by her fears. Guided by a mysterious man, she must master Korat-style Muay Thai to battle violent illusions and buried trauma. As darkness closes in, Koy fights to reclaim her true identity and survive the ultimate test within her mind.

Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join award-winning Malaysian actress Siti Saleha and her husband as they explore the city by day and venture into the night, discovering its vibrant culture and hidden treasures.

Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

After demons massacre his hometown and kill his loved ones, young Zhong Kui sets out for revenge. Along the way, he meets a half-demon princess and uncovers a sinister plot behind his former lovers mysterious resurrection. Wielding the Sacred Demon-Slaying Sword, he battles evil and becomes the legendary Demon Queller Zhong Kui.

A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

p.t: Live and Die in East LA
p.d: After treating a boy injured in a hit-and-run, ER doctor Attila is drawn into East L.A.’s underworld conflict. The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join Filipino actor, model and swimmer Enchong Dee and his celebrity friend Ria, to explore the highs and lows of Hong Kong. They are eager to push their boundaries in this thrilling new adventure.
Cult leader Yu Luo Sha slays four sect leaders. Zhuo Yi Hang confronts her but falls in love. When he marries another, her hair turns white, and she vows eternal vengeance.

After undergoing a secret government experiment, CIA operative Tara gains the ability to shapeshift into anyone through DNA transformation, making her the ultimate infiltrator. When her father is murdered and evidence points to her own agency, she is forced to go rogue. Now, she must stop stolen uranium from triggering a global nuclear catastrophe.

Western South Africa lies at the southern end of the African continent, with glorious beaches, rugged mountains and some of the best hiking trails to be found anywhere. Diamonds are mined along the west coast, and whales can be seen basking and breaching off the south coast. There is also a prison on Robben Island, now a UNESCO World Heritage Site, made famous by a political prisoner.

It's elimination day, and also the final day of Nostalgia Week. The MasterChef kitchen has been transformed into a 1970s-style lounge room. The challenge consists of two rounds. In round one, the contestants take turns identifying different cheeses. The first five to guess incorrectly will be sent to the second round, where they have 75 minutes to cook a dish inspired by classic Aussie recipes.

In Round 2 of the elimination challenge, Malissa, Ralph, Rhiannon, Robbie, and Rue must choose one dish out of ten to inspire their cook. However, two of the contestants have to make a last-minute decision and pivot to new dishes due to unforeseen issues. Will their decisions save them, or will they backfire? At the end of the cook, who will stay, and who will go home?

A goat forms an unexpected friendship with a guard dog and her pups and it blossoms into a loyal and trustworthy bond. Two Russian tortoises and a dog have been the best of friends at the moment they met. A female calico cat helps to nurse an injured lamb back to health, and they become inseparable. An injured crow found on the street regains its strength thanks to two dogs.

p.t: Adam and Poh's Great Australian Bites[Eng]
p.d: On their visit to the Northern Territory, Adam and Poh explore how indigenous, colonial and migrant cuisine has influenced the way Australian cook and eat. Adam visits Chung Wah Society and tastes the sartee, while Poh goes to enjoy the award-winning Laksa. Then they go to Kakadu National Park and create a dish that represent the Northern Territory.

Join Monica as she builds DIY craft-struments from everyday items that can be found in a recycling bin. Along for the ride are Pro Musicians and Junior Jammers who visit the backyard for a jam session. Their instruments are the inspiration for Monica’s craftstruments builds. Each episode concludes with Monica and her friends making some Backyard Beats!

In China’s far southwest, towering mountains divide the land, forming natural barriers which shelter nearly two thousand wild giant pandas. Dense forests are a paradise for red and white giant flying squirrels. On the mountain’s edge, endangered crested ibises have found new ways of coexisting with humans. Lured by tender grass in the high mountains, a takin herd sets out on an adventurous journey from the river valleys.

Three friends meet Shirley in Gu Lan County. They save a professor trapped in the Dragon Labyrinth, but two friends suffer from skin rashes after leaving the labyrinth. According to the notes written by Shirleys grandfather, the antidotes may be hidden at Tong Tian Buddhist Temple, so the four of them set off on a challenging journey for the cure.

In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the societys members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fus treasure. Meanwhile, Yus real identity also surfaces.

Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brothers murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

After hiding in Mount Zhang for seven years, Zhao Zi Long reunites with Liu Bei and Zhao Yun. Persuaded by Lius righteousness, Zhao rediscovers his aspirations and rallies his comrades to battle their enemies at Chang Ban Slope. He eventually defeats the enemies and emerges as the Great General of the Han Dynasty.

Tasked with absolving Wus wrongful conviction, Song Ci races against time to unveil the real culprit within two days. With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

Scholar Hu Ba and hunter Zhao venture to a bear-guarded cave to find an antidote to cure a sick villager. Attacked by the bear, they take refuge in a weasels cave where they encounter bizarre incidents and illusions. After Hu and Zhao dispelled the superstition trap and uncovered the true culprit, they successfully escape and rescue the people.

Having mastered the Shaolin martial arts, Fang Shi Yu yearns for a tranquil existence back home but becomes entangled in a corruption scandal. The governors henchman assigns a squad to eliminate witnesses and erase all evidence. Despite facing his best friends death and his mothers captivity, Fang vows to fight against the forces of evil.

Illusionist Pei of the Water Cult is trapped by Kong in a seal as he tries to kill to find the treasure. Kong leaves with an orphan Fang and 20 years later, Pei unseals himself to find the treasure again and kills Kong. As Fang learns the Fire skills from his master Kong, he vows to avenge his death but then discovers his ties to the Water Cult.

The newly completed Luo Yang Palace is set to fire by the Fire Dragon, resulting in the carpenters being missing or dead. Detective Dee is tasked to investigate the case. He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

Released from jail after an alleged offence, Lao Duan plans a scam to uncover the truth behind the past happenings. His three kids, each of distinct character, get involved in the plan. The family join hands to defeat the enemy, but at the same time, also making troubles for themselves. As the situation spirals, the ending ia anyones guess.

In an AI-driven world, the underground institute has developed chips which can activate supernatural power for profiteering. An accident occurs and killed Qian Hes mother. Qian He vows to avenge her mothers death and fight against the villains after provoking her supernatural power, finally unveiling the institutes hidden secret.

Young Ip Man battles a British kidnapping gang involved in trafficking Chinese women. As he fights to rescue the captives, he becomes a target of revenge, even endangering his friends. Recognizing his limits, Ip Man works with the patriots to expose the gang’s thrilling conspiracy.

To save his sister, top martial artist Constable Xie is forced by the Monster King to find all magical weapons for a tactical plot. The Monster Kings real purpose is to suck peoples blood and control the world through eudemon. Knowing his evil plan, Constable Xie decides to unlock his hidden power and begins a fierce battle with Monster King.

Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as tough detective John Kimble in Kindergarten Cop, going undercover as a teacher to find a drug lords wife. Packed with action, humor, and heart, it’s a classic comedy-thriller.
Sylvester Stallone stars in Daylight as a fallen hero racing to rescue commuters trapped in a collapsing NYC tunnel. Explosive action and suspense power this high-stakes disaster thriller!
During World War One, an English poacher, an American adventurer, and his attractive young daughter set out to destroy a German battle-cruiser awaiting repairs in an inlet just off Zanzibar.

p.t: The Librarian: The Return To King Solomons Mines
p.d: Adventurer Flynn Carsen receives a secret map to King Solomons Mines. When the map is stolen, Flynn sets out to find the map and the Key of Solomons book, without which the map is useless anyway.
Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

Returning to early 20th-century Shanghai to marry his fiancée, Chen Zhen discovers his revered martial arts master has died mysteriously. He launches a relentless quest for vengeance against the rival Japanese dojo responsible.
A mother fights to save the life of her ailing daughter after an unprecedented pandemic ravaged the planet, leaving resources so scarce you must pay for them with your life.

Moving to Thailand to work at an ice factory under a strict anti-violence vow, a young boy breaks his oath to confront a corrupt boss after his cousins disappear and he discovers the business is a front for drug smuggling.

When a washed-out German sailor in a drunken state agrees to take two British women from Gibraltar to the West Indies in his sailboat, they realize that it’s not going to be smooth sailing, and it will take all their wits to survive the trip.

p.t: The Librarian: The Curse Of The Judas Chalice
p.d: Losing his girlfriend because he was at an auction getting the magical Philosophers Stone, Flynn Carsen is ordered to take a vacation. In New Orleans he finds himself busy protecting the Judas Chalice and saving the world from vampires.

p.d: A bookworm becomes the librarian. Same night a magical spear gets stolen and hes off to get some real life experience around the globe on his quest for the spear - starting with being thrown off a plane over Amazonas by his cute helper.

p.d: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them. When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

A remote Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes known as the cursed ghost village Fengmen. Determined to uncover the truth, journalist Li Mu joins forces with officer Wan Feng to investigate the chilling incidents. As fear spreads among the villagers, the two risk their lives to expose the dark secrets behind Fengmen.

In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.
